name: triggers_and_returning
setup: CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, a INTEGER, b INTEGER, n INTEGER, v TEXT)
CREATE TABLE log(tag TEXT, id INTEGER)
CREATE TRIGGER t_bd BEFORE DELETE ON t FOR EACH ROW WHEN old.id % 2 = 0 BEGIN INSERT INTO log VALUES('bd', old.id); END
CREATE TRIGGER t_ad AFTER DELETE ON t FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT INTO log VALUES('ad', old.id); END
CREATE TRIGGER t_bu BEFORE UPDATE ON t FOR EACH ROW WHEN old.v='x' BEGIN INSERT INTO log VALUES('bu', old.id); END
CREATE TRIGGER t_au AFTER UPDATE ON t FOR EACH ROW BEGIN INSERT INTO log VALUES('au', new.id); END
verify: SELECT id,a,b,n,v FROM t ORDER BY id
SELECT tag,id FROM log ORDER BY id,tag

mutations.sql: DELETE FROM t WHERE a=1 RETURNING id
UPDATE t SET v='z' WHERE a=2 RETURNING id,v
